summary: Recorded one more checked premise as a negative result rather than a claim. liveBootstrap installs the bootstrap configuration and ends with the new configuration as latest while the empty previous configuration is committed at index zero, which looked as though it could let a snapshot record an empty configuration, since takeSnapshot only refuses when the FSM's applied index is behind committedIndex. Tracing the ordering closes it: a snapshot needs an applied entry, applied entries require a commit, and any commit index at or above latestIndex makes appendEntries replace the committed configuration with the latest one, so the committed configuration is corrected before the first snapshot index exists. The Behaviour recording that ordering was added with the liveBootstrap and takeSnapshot source ranges, no defect is asserted, and no execution was requested. The five questions and their accounts are unchanged; the remaining run time could still take an independent lead, but everything currently open has been resolved or explicitly refuted and every asserted finding carries receipts with reproduced witnesses.
